text:
Predicates:
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
NaziGerman(x) ::: x is a Nazi German.
MemberOfParliament(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
PartOfReichstag(x) ::: x is part of the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
HeinrichScmidt(h) ∧ NaziGerman(h) ∧ MemberOfParliament(h, prussianState) ∧ MemberOfParliament(h, naziReichstag) ::: Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician and a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Politician(x) ∧ PartOfReichstag(x)) ::: No politicians are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
